headline: The price of 24-karat gold in Pakistan rose by Rs11,500 per tola on Friday to Rs390,136, according to rates issued by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association, APP reports.

card.desc: Aalmi market mein sona $115 barh kar $3,676 fi ounce

caption:
Sone ki qeemat mein Rs11,500 fi tola ka izafa! 💰
APP ke mutabiq All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association ke jari karda rates mein Friday ko 24-karat sone ki qeemat Rs11,500 barh kar Rs390,136 fi tola ho gayi. 10 gram sona Rs9,859 barh kar Rs334,478 ka ho gaya. Aalmi market mein sona $115 barh kar $3,676 fi ounce raha, jabke chandi Rs277 barh kar Rs4,906 fi tola ho gayi.
Kya aap ke khayal mein sona mazeed mehnga hoga? Comment mein batayein 👇
